newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sanford Bernstein cuts reinsurers.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sanford Bernstein cuts reinsurers.

text.p: Sanford C. Bernstein analyst Weston Hicks said he downgraded PartnerRE Ltd and IPC Holdings Ltd to hold from buy on concern about price competition in the property-catastrophe reinsurance business.

Hicks said PartnerRE's decision to abandon its property-catastrophe specialist strategy and buy European direct reinsurer Societe Anonyme Francaise de Reassurances is a reflection of the tough industry conditions.
Hicks also said he downgraded Transatlantic Holdings Inc and Everest Reinsurance Holdings Inc to market perform from outperform.
He said he lowered his rating on Transatlantic and Everest on concern about decreasing demand as primary insurers increasingly retain more of their risk and on concern about global overcapacity.

Hicks said he believes this is the end of a more than five-year reinsurance growth cycle, spurred by a series of major catastrophes, and now believes the industry's growth is leveling and may decline.
He said he maintains a neutral rating on General Re Corp and maintains a buy on NAC Re Corp, which he said was cheap.
